- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on weathering and painting techniques for a car kit, including:
  - Choose the right paint (acrylic or enamel)
  - Prime the model

  - Apply a clear coat
  - Use masking for sharp lines
  - Weathering techniques: dust and dirt, tire wear, chips and scratches, rust and corrosion, glass and chrome detailing
